filterBuilder.controlledBody: Use filters and logic with their change callbacks when the current query belongs in a URL, a server request, or application state. The uncontrolled defaults are useful for local, self-contained views.
filterBuilder.asyncOptionsBody: Provide loadOptions for remote search. Requests are debounced and cancelled when a newer query replaces them; option lists virtualize automatically from 100 items.
filterBuilder.serverFilteringBody: FilterBuilder deliberately owns only condition editing. Serialize its JSON-safe state into a query or request body, validate it on the server, and translate operators through a field allowlist. createFilterPredicate is available for small client-side datasets.
filterBuilder.fieldsProp: The available fields and their editors. A field can be text, number, select, multiSelect, boolean, date, dateRange, or custom.
filterBuilder.filtersProp: Controlled condition list. Each clause contains an id, field id, operator, and JSON-safe value.
filterBuilder.defaultFiltersProp: Initial condition list for uncontrolled use.
filterBuilder.logicProp: Whether all conditions or any condition must match.
filterBuilder.onFiltersChangeProp: Called after a condition is added, edited, or removed.
filterBuilder.allowDuplicateFieldsProp: Allows more than one condition for the same field.
filterBuilder.maxFiltersProp: Caps the total number of conditions that can be added.
filterBuilder.readOnlyProp: Renders the active conditions without mutation controls.
